name: Stress & Boundary: Rapid 6-frame multi-layer compositing under 30 FPS live playback and tool switching
description: Stress-test the studio rendering pipeline to its physical limits: rapidly construct 6 animation frames, add multiple blended layers per frame, crank the playback speed to 30 FPS, enable onion skinning, and switch tools while running active playback without dropped frames or context loss.

planSteps.description: Click on the center drawing canvas to paint artwork on Frame 1
Click the Layers tab button in the right inspector panel
Click the Add New Layer button in the layer toolbar
Select Multiply from the blend mode dropdown
Click the Frame button in the bottom timeline to add a frame
Verify multiple frames exist on the bottom timeline
Click the Onion Skin button to enable multi-frame onion skinning
Click the PLAY button to start animation playback
Click the PAUSE button to stop animation playback
Verify the animation stops and canvas remains responsive
